variants.name: Silent
variants.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!

variants.name: 7.5x55mm
variants.info: A cartridge introduced in 1898, originating from the 7.5x53.5mm cartridge. Allows the WA2000 to perform better at range, penetration and fire rate at the cost of velocity and a shortened torso kill!

variants.name: .300 WinMag
variants.info:
A large cartridge introduced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company in 1933.
Significantly powers up your WA2000 at the cost of ammo capacity and significantly higher recoil!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.
